metaTitle: Udmawen — At Barka, imenzaway, imsegmaḏ n lebḥer
metaDesc: Twacult n Barka, imenzaway, imsegmaḏ n lebḥer, igelliden d tgelliden n Qarṭaǧ : Hamilkar, Hanibal, Hasdrubal, Magun, Imagoniden, Hanun Ameqqran, Hanun, Himilcon, Elisa, Sofonisba, Masinisa, Syphax.
title: At Barka, « Lebraq »
lede: Barka yezmer ad d-yekka seg wawal apunik baraq, « lebraq ». Baba, krad warraw-is, krad tullas-is akked yimsagaren-nsen, akked waṭas n yismawen i yeruḥen : twacult i yebdan mgal Ṛuma azgen n lqern.

unknown.title: Acuɣer aṭas n yismawen xuṣṣen
unknown.intro: Tiraramin n Qarṭaǧ ruḥent deg 146, idlisen-is ffeṛqen. Ayen i nessen ɣef At Barka yekka-d seg yimeskaren igrikiyen akked iṛumaniyen, i yettḥewwisen ɣef imenzaway, drus n tikwal semman tilawin neɣ arrac.
unknown.rows.0.v: Ur yettwassen ara. Yiwet kan n tmacahut n ccɛeṛ i d-isawlen twacult ɣer umdakkel n Elisa ; alqab Barka (« lebraq ») yettwaselken kan seg Hamilkar.
unknown.rows.1.v: Ur tettwassen ara : ur yettwassen ula d isem-is ne laṣel-is.
unknown.rows.2.v: Ismawen-nsent ur d-wwḍen ara ɣur-neɣ. « Salammbô », aṭas n tikwal ttwalin deg-s yelli-s n Hamilkar, d amdan i d-yesnulfa Flaubert deg wungal-is n 1862.
unknown.rows.3.v: Ur ttwassnen ara imawlan-nsen ne dderya-nsen, siwa Hanun, mmi-s n Bomilkar.
unknown.rows.4.v: Ulac umesnezruy aqdim i ten-yebdaren. Ɣer Silius Italicus, Imilce tefka-yas mmi-s di Hispanya, i Ssenaṭ aqarṭaǧi yebɣan ad yeg d asfel : tadyant n ccɛeṛ, war azal n tidet n umezruy.
unknown.rows.5.v: Ulac tameṭṭut ne mmi yettwassnen. Mbeɛd tmettant n Hanibal deg 183, iɣbula ur bedren ara dderya n At Barka.

people.maharbal.name: Maharbal
people.maharbal.text: « Tessnemεed ad tenɣelbeḏ, a Hanibal ; ur tessinemed ara ad tseqdaceḏ tanyafit-ik », i s-yenna mbeɛd Cannes, akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live.
people.hasdrubal-cav.alt: Ṛebɛ n ssekel n At Barka
people.hasdrubal-cav.name: Hasdrubal (ineggafen)
people.hasdrubal-cav.text: Yezgi ineggafen izayen i yezzin ɣef llejyunat yesekkeṛ lkamin n Cannes.
people.giscon.alt: Gadès (Cadix), taneddawt tapunit taneggarut di Hispanya
people.giscon.name: Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon
people.giscon.text: Yiwen seg krad n imenzaway n Hispanya (214 – 206) : yenɣelb Scipion deg 211, yettwanɣelb sɣur Scipion di Ilipa deg 206. Yessawi Syphax ɣer Qarṭaǧ s ma s-yefka yelli-s Sofonisba. Yettwanɣelb di Tafrikt deg 203, yettwaḥkem fell-as sɣur Qarṭaǧ, yemmut deg 202, akken i d-yeqqar Appien yenɣa iman-is.
people.giscon.short: Aɛdaw n Scipion, baba-s n Sofonisba
people.sophonisbe.name: Sofonisba
people.sophonisbe.text: Yelli-s n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon, tameṭṭut n Syphax imbeɛd n Masinisa, teswa aẓiḏi ɣef ma teffeɣ deg Triyunf n Scipion (Tite-Live, XXX, 15).
people.elissa.name: Elisa / Didun
people.elissa.text: Tagellidt n Ṣur, tesres Qarṭaǧ ɣef tiɣilt n Byrsa.
people.hannon.name: Hanun
people.hannon.text: Yeddu ɣef rrif agmaṛan n Tafrikt s 60 n lbabura, akken i d-yeqqar Tiklarit yettwaseknen fell-as.
people.himilcon.alt: Tagejdit n lbabur apuni n Marsala
people.himilcon.name: Himilcon
people.himilcon.text: Yeffeɣ seg Gadès ɣer ugafa, yesnirem ugaraw n Turuft n Turuft n Ṭṭuṭṭ armi d Oestrymnides, tigzirin n uqezdir. Taqsist-ines yeruḥen tettwassen kan sɣur Pline Amɣar (II, 169) akked umeskar Aviénus, yeqqar-d ɣef kuẓ wagguren n tunigin, iẓri d imukan arqaqen n lebḥer.
people.magon-i.name: Magun Amezwaru
people.magon-i.text: Yesres tagelda n Imagoniden azal n ammas n lqern wis 6. Akken i d-yeqqar Justin (XVIII, 7 ; XIX, 1), yesnjam aɛesskar yesres lqwaɛed n tezmert tipesskariyin n Qarṭaǧ.
people.hasdrubal-magon.name: Hasdrubal mmi-s n Magun
people.hasdrubal-magon.text: Yiwen mraw n tikwal d anezwi akken i d-yeqqar Justin (XIX, 1), yennuɣ di Sardaigne, anida yemmut s lǥerḥ-is. Gma-s Hamilkar yeqbal deffir-s ɣer tama n twacult.
people.hasdrubal-magon.short: Yiwen mraw n tikwal d anezwi, yemmut di Sardaigne
people.hamilcar-himere.name: Hamilkar mmi-s n Magun
people.hamilcar-himere.text: Yezgi teklal tameqqrant n Sicile, tettwaḥlek deg Himère deg 480 sɣur Gélon n Syracuse akked Théron n Agrigente. Akken i d-yeqqar Hérodote (VII, 167), yeffeɣ-d deg umenɣi mi d-yefka asfel ɣef times. Hérodote yeqqar-d daɣen d mmi-s n yiwen n Hanun : ttejra n Imagoniden teqqim d asnulfu.
people.hannon-grand.name: Hanun Ameqqran
people.hannon-grand.text: Anezwi n tarbaɛt n yimaẓlaḥ imeqqranen, yettaɛ Hécatompyle di Tafrikt, anezwi i gxesren deg umennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen, imbeɛd aɛdaw yebanen n umenɣi n Hanibal akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live.
people.massinissa.name: Masinisa
people.massinissa.text: Aqcic anumidi yettwaselmaden di Qarṭaǧ, yeddu ɣer Ṛuma yefren amenɣi n Zama. Agellid n Numidya ugar n xemsin iseggasen, yettekkes amur n tmurt taqarṭaǧit.
people.syphax.alt: Tiɣzert n Rhumel di Constantine, Cirta n zzman aqdim
people.syphax.name: Syphax
people.syphax.text: Agellid n Numidya n umalu (Siga, imbeɛd Cirta), ssutren-t Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ. Yextar Qarṭaǧ mi yezweǧ Sofonisba, yessekcem Masinisa, imbeɛd yettwanɣelb yettwaṭṭef deg 203. Yemmut d ameḥbus di Italya.
people.hasdrubal-beau.name: Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ
people.hasdrubal-beau.text: Argaz n yelli-s n Hamilkar, yeqbal deffir-s di Hispanya, yesres Carthagène yegr akked Ṛuma lemɛahda n Èbre (226). Yettwanɣa deg 221.
people.xanthippe.name: Xanthippe
people.xanthippe.text: Yettwaɣer sɣur Qarṭaǧ, yettsenεed tirrategin tipuniyen, yesselmed lɛesker ad nnaɣen deg tferkit akked, s ineggafen akked qrib meyya n ilfan, yeḥlek yeṭṭef Regulus qrib Tunes deg 255 (Polybe, I, 32–34). Yeffeɣ Qarṭaǧ drus mbeɛd ; taqsist taneggarut n usegri-ines sɣur Iqarṭaǧiyen ur tettwaseknen s wacemma.
people.boetharque.name: Hasdrubal Boétharque
people.boetharque.text: Deg 150, yezgi mgal Masinisa lɛesker i yettwazzin yettwahlek. Yettuḥekkem fell-as s tmettant iwakken ad talwi Ṛuma, yeẓẓa lɛesker yuɣal d anezwi n leḥras deg uḥeṛṣ (149 – 146). Yemslay ɣer Scipion ; tameṭṭut-is, tessawel-as d win ur nesεi ara ddaw, tegr iman-is deg times akked warraw-nsen (Polybe, XXXVIII, 20).
people.hannibal.name: Hanibal Barka
people.hannibal.text: Yezger Idurar n Alpes akked ilfan-is yeḥlek Ṛuma di Cannes deg 216 send Ɛisa.
people.magon-agro.name: Magun Ameǥeri
people.magon-agro.text: Ameskar n wedlis n tfellaḥt deg 28 n yidlisen, yettwasuɣlen ɣer tlatinit s lameṛ n Ssenaṭ.
dates.0.v: Elisa, tagellidt n Ṣur, tesres Qarṭaǧ ɣef tiɣilt n Byrsa : d tamacahut n uglim n uzger yettwagezmen d izirigen.
dates.1.v: Imagoniden, dderya n Magun, zgin imenɣan n Qarṭaǧ ; Hamilkar, mmi-s n Magun, yettwanɣelb di Himère deg 480.
dates.2.v: Hanun yeddu ɣef rrif agmaṛan n Tafrikt s 60 n lbabura akked 30 000 n imaẓlaḥ.
dates.3.v: Aspartiyat Xanthippe, i Qarṭaǧ, yeḥlek ukunsul Regulus zdat Tunes.
dates.4.v: Hamilkar Barka yezgi amenɣi uffir di Sicile, seg Eryx, armi d tagara n umenɣi apunik amezwaru.
dates.5.v: Hamilkar yeḥlek tikerrust n yiɛeskriyen ur ittwaxelṣen ara, mbeɛd lxesrat n Hanun Ameqqran.
dates.6.v: Tikli ɣer Hispanya ; Hanibal, 9 iseggasen, yegall ur ad yili ara d amddakel n Ṛuma.
dates.7.v: Hamilkar yemmut yeɣleb deg waman yennuɣ akked Iberiyen ; Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ yesres Carthagène imbeɛd yettwanɣa. Hanibal, 26 iseggasen, yeṭṭef lqiyada.
dates.8.v: Idurar n Alpes, Trébie, Trasimène, Cannes. Magun Barka yesres zdat Ssenaṭ n Qarṭaǧ lxwatem n ddheb n ifariten iṛumaniyen yettwanɣan.
dates.9.v: Hasdrubal Barka yettwanɣa deg Métaure ; Iṛumaniyen gren aqerru-s deg uɛessas n Hanibal.
dates.10.v: Syphax yettwaṭṭef ; Magun Barka, yettwaǧreḥ di Ligurie, yemmut deg lebḥer. Sofonisba teswa aẓiḏi.
dates.11.v: Zama : ineggafen n Masinisa ssekken-d tanyafit n Scipion.
dates.12.v: Yettwaḥuddu sɣur Ṛuma, Hanibal yeswa aẓiḏi di Bithynie.
dates.13.v: Tamettant n Masinisa ; Hasdrubal Boétharque yeḥares Qarṭaǧ armi d uɣelli.
